description: Incoterms 2020 responsibility matrix: for one rule (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP, FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF) or all 11, the transport modes it fits, where risk passes, and whether seller or buyer handles main carriage, loading, export and import clearance, import duties, unloading and insurance. Optional check flags a sea-only rule used for containers or non-sea transport. A factual summary, not the ICC rule text or legal advice. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

mode.description: Optional transport for a fit check: sea, container, air, road, rail or multimodal
